# rqbit source provenance

`rqbit/` is the source archive of https://github.com/ikatson/rqbit at
`a499d2f243d124e144aef137afe7cb304a6e3f36` (v9.0.1), Apache-2.0.
The upstream LICENSE is retained. SeedHop patches are described in
`docs/ENGINE-AUDIT.md`; the ordered patches are in `vendor/patches/` (reliability, BEP 52, metadata replay guard, transfer/file controls, v2 wire corrections, uTP fallback, simultaneous hybrid swarms, MSE/PE encryption, magnet proof discovery/private tracker isolation, legacy payload-derived Merkle layers, dual-hash magnet discovery, early private metadata teardown and single-response DHT recursion, BEP 9 metadata wire conformance, shared metadata resource bounds, filename sanitization and saved-path migration, live interest and choke handling, authenticated serving and verification ownership, shared hash rate policy, additive extension IDs and private PEX policy, owned LSD subscriptions and announcement lifetime, legacy layer-fetch peer state and progress, semantic hash rejects and meta-version priority). Desktop/web assets are upstream references, not used by
the native app. No upstream instruction file is a product dependency.

Unicode filename collision data is licensed under the notice in `UNICODE-LICENSE.txt`, which is bundled with the native app.
